issues.desc: CHK-005 smoke coverage omits several required failure-mode smokes from docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md: merge-main conflict blocks at mergeMain, refreshStale=false blocks stale evidence, stale evidence that requires command rerun prints rerun commands, and prepare-generated metadata blocks at cleanTree until committed. The linked decision doc covers these, so this is non-blocking, but PLAN/verificationIntent should make them explicit for this high-risk lifecycle command.

The referenced done-prepare execution plan still says Status: proposed while the story background says the plan was accepted; reconcile that source-of-truth status so implementation agents know the product scope is authorized, not just drafted.

CHK-005 is framed as smoke coverage rather than a user-observable outcome. The behaviors it covers are valuable, but the checklist would be more product-coherent if the item names the reliability/readiness outcome and leaves smoke coverage as verification detail.
